The Department of Law is among the departments which were established with the formation of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan in 2009. The primary objective of the Department of Law is to promote and facilitate “Law” in society and produce law researchers and scholars. Acknowledgement of law is essential to streamline and maintain law and order in society.
The Department of Law of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is equipped with well qualified, foreign-trained young faculty members; who firmly believe that not only academic excellence but professional competence acquired through experience and practice with efficient lawyers is the main yardstick of success.
In this modern era, the study of law has numerous benefits. Firstly, it gives awareness of the right and duties of a person. Secondly, it helps society to produce law-abiding citizens. Law is a system of rules and guidelines which are enforced through the social institution to govern behaviour, wherever possible. The law faculty is working hard to promote legal education and to uplift politics, economics and society in numerous ways and to serve as a social mediator of relations between people.
Vision
To upraise the law department, and transform it into Faculty of Law having specialized schools and centers.
Specific Goals
To establish a unique department of Research and academic excellence in law in Pakistan.
Bring together colleagues with mutual research interest and provide them with an institutional home for their work.
Flag, Publicize and market to the world at large, the research strengths housed under the department.
Carve a distinctive identity for its members within the wider academic fraternity.
Specific Objectives
To link up colleagues, whose work transcends various areas of public and private law.
To act as a focus for the pursuit of research and teaching interest in all areas of legal issues.
